files.purpose: Authoritative dependency map linking canonical documents to their stable ordered-array reader paths, tracking source blob SHA, last commit SHA, and reader metadata.

Deterministic sync engine: reads dependency-map.json, compares current git blob and commit SHAs of canonical sources, regenerates stable ordered-array JSON readers for changed sources only, and updates dependency provenance.

Dependency-sync workflow: runs deterministically when canonical source documents or dependency-map change, executes sync-readers.js, and commits updated readers and dependency-map.json with infinite-loop prevention.
files.content:
name: gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json'
      - 'Agents.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'MANIFEST.md'
      - 'config.json'
      - 'tests/step-3-evaluation.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/sync-readers.js'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-readers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(deps): sync stable readers')"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Execute deterministic reader sync
        run: node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/sync-readers.js

      - name: Commit reader and provenance changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/readers/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No reader or provenance changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(deps): sync stable readers and provenance [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}
          fi

files.purpose: Catalog linking enumerated truth-reading document keys to dependency-map keys, human-readable labels, and target active projection output paths.
Control selector with strict enumerated booleans. Workers flip specific booleans to true to request a seeded challenge.
Worker seed submission payload. Worker places observed truth seeds in active projection order.
Status ledger tracking the current or last completed truth challenge cycle.

Core workflow engine for truth challenges: validates selector, checks reader provenance against dependency-map, generates active projections with distributed CSPRNG seeds, records secure workflow-owned state, verifies evidence, and performs atomic PASS reset or zero-mutation FAIL.

GitHub Actions challenge workflow: triggers on selector or evidence commits, differentiates between selection and evidence phases, executes truth-engine, commits active projections on select, executes atomic reset on PASS, and strictly does nothing on FAIL.
files.content:
name: truth-reader-challenge

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'truth-reader/selector.json'
      - 'truth-reader/evidence.json'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  truth-challenge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(truth):')"
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Detect Trigger Phase
        id: phase
        run: |
          CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
          if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "truth-reader/evidence.json"; then
            echo "mode=verify" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif echo "$CHANGED" | grep -q "truth-reader/selector.json"; then
            echo "mode=select" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "mode=select" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Handle Selection and Seeding
        if: steps.phase.outputs.mode == 'select'
        run: |
          node truth-reader/scripts/truth-engine.js --select
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add truth-reader/active/ truth-reader/status.json
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No active projections or status changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth): issue active seeded projections [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}
          fi

      - name: Handle Evidence Verification
        if: steps.phase.outputs.mode == 'verify'
        run: |
          node truth-reader/scripts/truth-engine.js --verify
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add truth-reader/active/ truth-reader/selector.json truth-reader/evidence.json truth-reader/status.json
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No PASS reset changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth): atomic PASS reset and verification [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}
          fi
